comparison.objective: Store a normal LiPo in a fire-safe box and isolate a swollen pack in sand; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard classification and careful container placement versus bimanual precision impact tooling and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly segregated batteries versus four fracture events, all fragments contained, and undamaged shell and coils. Detailed battery-placement thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Hazard-aware sorting does not overlap meaningfully with mechanical insert finishing.
